blurb:
Hey Ladies! Welcome to the most fun Kelowna Bachelorette Wine Tour in the Okanagan! Looking for that final “let your hair down and party” wine tour experience with your gal pals? We’ve got you covered with our all inclusive Kelowna Bachelorette Wine Tour designed just for you!

We’ve taken care of all the details including a special toast for the bride to be, complimentary bubbly and a hand picked selection of vineyards and wineries to ensure a wine filled good time on this special day! All Kelowna Bachelorette Wine Tour packages also include a Bluetooth Karaoke mic for you to rock out with in the van! Enjoy VIP treatment, front of the line access to award winning wineries, ride in style in our customized brand new luxury vans and get pampered on this 5 winery experience!

This is the #1 Best selling Kelowna Bachelorette Wine Tour, and for good reason! Young, energetic guides, incredible playlists, endless photos taken of your group, and amazing winery experiences throughout the day.
